# Pull request templates

[`default.md`](default.md) is the active pull request template. It asks for one
reversible purpose, affected boundaries and risk, observed evidence, skipped
checks, and rollback or forward-fix notes.

Keep detailed workflow rules in [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) and
architecture rules in
[`docs/architecture/architecture.md`](../../docs/architecture/architecture.md);
the template should link to those authorities rather than duplicate them.
